previous_statement: By the definition of a_n, ||T_n(Z^dagger dot Z)|| >= a_n||Z^dagger dot Z||; by lem-hcb3-uniform-square-lower, ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-K_sq*e)||Z||^2. Combining these inequalities with node 1.2.2.1 gives ||T_n(Z)||^2 >= [a_n(1-K_sq*e)-C_prod*e]||Z||^2 for every Z.
new_statement: Split first according to whether S_P is zero. If S_P={0}, then M_m tensor S_P={0} for every m and the root lower estimate is immediate, without defining any a_m. In the remaining branch S_P!={0}; then for every n the ratio set defining a_n is nonempty and bounded below, and a_n is a finite nonnegative real. In this branch the definition of a_n, lem-hcb3-uniform-square-lower, and node 1.2.2.1 give ||T_n(Z)||^2 >= [a_n(1-K_sq*e)-C_prod*e]||Z||^2 for every Z.
